h4_interpretation: Legacy pooled correlation, kept for the dashboard: mechanically coupled by the update rule and pooled across questions. Use h4_slopes instead.

h4_slopes.method: Per condition and question: OLS of (assistant_log10 - log_truth) on (agent_log10_before - log_truth) [+ (pop_median_log10 - log_truth) for C2..C6/P1..P4]; slopes averaged over questions with a bootstrap 95% CI over questions.
h4_slopes.interpretation: slope_user ~0: the assistant answers from its own view; ~1: it echoes the user's guess. slope_crowd separates echoing the crowd median. Descriptive, not causal.
